instagram.body:
Teaching her money confidence early… but with mom still in control. 💳✨

Custom card, real-life spending, savings goals, and total peace of mind with Cash App’s parent-managed account. #ad #cashapppartner
I don't know about you guys, but I had to figure out how to manage my money as a young adult because my parents didn't have the digital tools, so they couldn't really teach me in the way that I want to be able to teach my kids. And I want them to feel confident early on, which is why I love Cash App's parent managed account for kids. And do you guys want to know one of our favorite parts, is actually customizing a Cash App card that actually feels like her style, so she's even more excited about how we can use it to help her learn. She can use the card when we're out together, which I can tell is really helping her build her confidence. And because I set up recurring allowance and a custom spend limit, I feel like I'm actually teaching her how to stay within a budget. Everything is managed from my Cash App, so there's no separate app needed. And I get real-time notifications when the card is used, and I can lock or unlock if I need to. It's super easy to use, and there's no hidden fees or subscription costs, so it gives her that sense of independence while I still have my peace of mind. It's literally such a great way to start teaching real-life skills early, so download Cash App and set up your parent manage account for your kids today.
